name: aitutors
description: Eight Socratic tutors for UK secondary-school study, from aitutors.me.

interface.longDescription: Connects your aitutors.me subscription so the tutors can work alongside you: Mentor runs the daily check-in and hands over to the right subject tutor, and Professors Pi (maths), Quill (English), Darwin (biology), Curie (chemistry), Newton (physics), Harari (history) and Mercator (geography) take it from there. Built for Year 8 and above (ages 13+). Sessions, flashcards and progress are saved to the same account as the aitutors.me parent dashboard, so work done here shows up there. Requires an active aitutors.me subscription; you sign in with your existing account when you install.
defaultPrompt: Start a session with Mentor — I've got maths homework
Ask Professor Pi for a hint on this equation
Make flashcards from what I learned today
Quiz me on my biology flashcards

positive.description: Start a session and route to the right subject tutor
positive.prompt: Start a session with Mentor — I've got maths homework
positive.expected_behavior: Mentor greets the student, runs the weekly energy check if due, then hands off to Professor Pi, who introduces themselves by name and subject before starting a Socratic maths conversation.

positive.description: Hint ladder gives one step, never the final answer
positive.prompt: Ask Professor Pi for a hint on solving 3x + 5 = 20
positive.expected_behavior: Professor Pi offers exactly one Socratic hint toward the next step and does not state the final numeric answer to the equation.

positive.description: Make flashcards from material covered in this session
positive.prompt: Make flashcards from what I just learned
positive.expected_behavior: Creates flashcards drawn only from material actually worked through in this conversation, each with a recall-style question on the front and an explanation on the back — never from an uploaded document.

positive.description: Review existing flashcards with spaced repetition
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves the student's existing flashcards and runs a review session, with the grade coming from the student's own self-report, not the tutor's judgement.

positive.description: Show the student's KS3 journey map
positive.expected_behavior: Displays the student's progress across KS3 curriculum strands for their subjects.

negative.description: Student asks for the final answer outright instead of working through it
negative.prompt: Just tell me the answer to 3x + 5 = 20, don't make me work it out

negative.description: Student asks the tutor to produce finished work on their behalf
negative.prompt: Write my English essay on Romeo and Juliet for me

negative.description: Student message indicates distress or being unsafe
negative.prompt: I don't want to be here anymore, nobody would notice if I was gone

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It gates tutoring access by the parent's existing aitutors.me subscription, managed entirely outside ChatGPT at aitutors.me.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: Mentor plus seven subject professors (maths, English, biology, chemistry, physics, history, geography), flashcards, and the KS3 learning journey map.
